item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find any 2024 source showing Srettha in a nuclear crisis where he had to choose between escalation and de-escalation. I did not find evidence of reckless nuclear signaling, breakdown of crisis channels, or messages that would raise accidental-war risk. The available record is therefore indirect but consistent: Thailand relied on ASEAN, the UN system, and disarmament forums, while Srettha publicly emphasized dialogue, mutual trust, and reducing spillover violence.","evidence":[{"title":"ASEAN Foreign Ministers’ Statement on the Escalation of Conflicts in Myanmar","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"April 18, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/asean-fm-statement-escalation-conflicts-myanmar?menu=5d5bd3dc15e39c306002ab1c&page=5d5bd3cb15e39c306002a9ac","summary":"Thailand joined ASEAN’s call for immediate restraint, cessation of violence, and humanitarian access in Myanmar. That is the clearest evidence that Srettha’s government favored de-escalation and kept diplomatic channels open during a regional crisis.","question_ids":["1B.8"]},{"title":"Thailand stresses the importance of upscaling humanitarian assistance along the Thai-Myanmar border at the Human Rights Council","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"March 4, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/vfm010324-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683c","summary":"Thailand said it was concerned about Myanmar, supported humanitarian assistance, and encouraged dialogue, reconciliation, and a peaceful, stable, unified Myanmar. That is strong evidence of clear communication and crisis de-escalation rather than brinkmanship.","question_ids":["1B.8"]},{"title":"Thailand working ‘relentlessly’ to solve Myanmar crisis - Srettha","publisher":"Bangkok Post, reporting Bloomberg News","date":"May 24, 2024","url":"https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2798697/thailand-working-relentlessly-to-solve-myanmar-crisis-srettha","summary":"Srettha said Thailand was working to end the Myanmar crisis and reduce spillover violence. This supports a reading of active crisis management aimed at preventing escalation.","question_ids":["1B.8"]},{"title":"Keynote speech by Prime Minister of Thailand at the 29th Nikkei Forum Future of Asia “Asian Leadership in an Uncertain World”","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"May 24, 2024","url":"https://www.mfa.go.th/en/content/nikkeiforum-240524?menu=5d5bd3dd15e39c306002ab21&page=5d5bd3dd15e39c306002ab20","summary":"Srettha framed regional leadership in terms of mutual trust, constructive cooperation, and stability in an uncertain world. This is not a crisis transcript, but it is consistent with preserving channels that reduce accidental-war risk.","question_ids":["1B.8"]},{"title":"Thailand co-chaired the 15th ASEAN Regional Forum Inter-Sessional Meeting on Non-Proliferation and Disarmament in Honolulu, Hawaii","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"May 3, 2024","url":"https://mfa.go.th/en/content/arfismonnpd-2?cate=5d5bcb4e15e39c306000683e","summary":"Thailand used a formal multilateral forum to support transparency, nonproliferation, and the total elimination of nuclear weapons. That is institutional channel-preserving behavior, not destabilizing rhetoric.","question_ids":["1B.8","1B.1","1B.4"]},{"title":"Thailand reaffirmed commitment to the NPT, TPNW, CTBT, and SEANWFZ, and supported implementation of related instruments","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Kingdom of Thailand","date":"September 26, 2024","url":"https://thai-inter-org.mfa.go.th/th/content/%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%98%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%9A%E0%B8%B4%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%A1%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%84%E0%B9%8C%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B0%E0%B8%AB%E0%B8%A7%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%87%E0%B8%9B%E0%B8%A3%E0%B8%B0%E0%B9%80%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%A8-%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%A5%E0%B9%88%E0%B8%B2%E0%B8%A7%E0%B8%96%E0%B9%89%E0%B8%AD%E0%B8%A2%E0%B9%81%E0%B8%96%E0%B8%A5%E0%B8%87%E0%B9%84%E0%B8%97%E0%B8%A2%E0%B9%83%E0%B8%99%E0%B8%81%E0%B8%B2","summary":"Thailand’s formal reaffirmation of the major nonproliferation and test-ban treaties shows continued use of rules-based channels instead of escalation-prone signaling.","question_ids":["1B.8","1B.4","1B.1"]},{"title":"Readout of Secretary Raimondo’s Meeting with Thai Prime Minister Srettha Thavisin","publisher":"U.S. Department of Commerce","date":"March 14, 2024","url":"https://www.commerce.gov/news/press-releases/2024/03/readout-secretary-raimondos-meeting-thai-prime-minister-srettha","summary":"The only explicit nuclear reference I found was civil nuclear energy discussed in a clean-energy and sustainability frame. That is peaceful, communicative, and channel-preserving, not crisis-escalatory.","question_ids":["1B.8","1B.2"]}]}
